EdgeDock needs Usage Access to show your recently-used apps.
Notification permission is required so Android can keep the dock alive in the background.
On some phones (especially Xiaomi/HyperOS), battery restrictions can kill the dock. Open app settings and allow unrestricted battery use / autostart.
Enable Usage Access in settings to see recently used apps — or start typing to search all apps.

EdgeDock is a local quick-launch overlay. It does not include ads, analytics, crash reporting, or any network access.

Permissions
• Overlay (draw over other apps): draws the search bubble and panel on top of other apps.
• Usage Access: orders the empty-query list by recently used apps. Optional — search still works without it.
• Notifications: required by Android so the foreground service that hosts the bubble can stay alive.
• Boot completed: restarts the dock after reboot if you left it enabled.

Data
EdgeDock stores only on-device preferences (dock on/off, bubble position, list/grid layout). It never uploads installed-app lists, usage history, or any other personal data.

Contact
For privacy questions about this app, contact the developer via the store listing or the project repository.
